name: NEXTEP Broadband
summary: Business broadband provider backed by NEC Australia; sold ADSL/SDSL/secure networking via channel/agent model (incl. Swift Internet as an agent) (ABN 44 138 187 739).

events.details: NEC venture; no clear record of end. The proposal's 2006 partnership-ABN cancellation is not the ISP death: Nextep traded on as an NEC division and then AAPT brand until its product homepage became a transition page around 2013-14. AAPT takeover Dec 2012; site reduced to migration page by May 2014.

refs.label: May 2013 still a complete Nextep-branded ISP product site under AAPT
By May 2014 the homepage was only a migration notice; the 1 Jul 2006 partnership ABN cancellation (44 138 187 739, NEC Australia & XDSL) did not end the brand
